items.text: Scientists now flank correctly during combat, improving their behavior.
Rare mainland shipping containers require lock‑breaking or code notes to open, feature stronger explosives needed for code‑locked doors and lock health UI appears only when aimed at the lock.
Extraction map expanded with new monuments and a 3 km procedural scene for raids.
Extracted loot is automatically banked in a stash, and raider NPCs now spawn at the start of raids.
Arrow customization added: a deployable fletching jig for crafting and a clear‑customization action to revert skinned arrows.
40 mm flare now appears white, uses road‑flare visuals, and self‑destructs if shot into the ground at close range.
40 mm Incendiary Grenade damage rebalanced with updated visual and sound effects and a new icon.
Prototype deployable trampoline lets players place a bounce platform for movement and tactical options.
FPV drone scripts fixed to prevent flag and sound‑modulation errors, improving drone reliability.
Conveyor belts now move up to 24 items per tick, speeding up base logistics.
Building blocks no longer become invisible, ensuring structures stay visible.
Reload bar displayed beside the weapon when using the shoulder camera.
UI scrolling performance improved, panel flicker resolved, and video playback crashes fixed when killed or dismounted during tape playback.
FPV drone and goggles are being integrated (WIP).

2026-11-10.summary:

- 40 mm flare now appears white, uses road‑flare visuals, and self‑destructs if shot into the ground at close range.
- 40 mm Incendiary Grenade damage rebalanced with updated visual and sound effects and a new icon.

### Deployables & Vehicles
- Prototype deployable trampoline lets players place a bounce platform for movement and tactical options.
- FPV drone scripts fixed to prevent flag and sound‑modulation errors, improving drone reliability.

- Building blocks no longer become invisible, ensuring structures stay visible.
- Reload bar displayed beside the weapon when using the shoulder camera.
- UI scrolling performance improved, panel flicker resolved, and video playback crashes fixed when killed or dismounted during tape playback.

### New Content
- FPV drone and goggles are being integrated (WIP).

items.text: Fixed bugs that left players behind boats, caused sleeping, sinking boats, or duplicated/incorrect entities during server transfers.
Enabled exiting vehicles and crossing between seamless servers, adding full neighbor connections, server links, vehicle transfers, and client handling for smoother travel.
Rewrote the conveyor system to move a fixed amount of items per tick, speed up when outputs near full, and resume scans after multi‑tick transfers.
Fixed a UI bug where powered storage adaptors incorrectly displayed a power requirement message.
Added two Minicopter wrecks per map at monuments that can be repaired for gears, metal fragments, high‑quality metal, and a random tier‑2 modular car part.
Implemented BoatDockTrigger on all fishing village docks, preventing vehicles from getting stuck and gently pulling them to the centre of water docks.
Fixed AK rifle stacking display so a stack correctly shows 20 AKs instead of an erroneous label.
Added a toggle to keep mouse sensitivity consistent across all weapons.
Added an ammo indicator to the 40 mm Flashbang grenade.

Introduced a major expansion to the experimental Rust XCOM mode, adding proper weapon handling, new enemy types, ladders, doors, manual furnace, full armoury with loadouts, melee options, overwatch, research, crafting, bases, terrain changes, camera controls, combat animations, cover improvements, loot drops, persistent squads, resource economy, repeatable raids, battle camera, and many other gameplay systems.
Fixed a crash caused by a NullReferenceException in the Wire Tool preview, preventing crashes and missing wire previews.

Cargo ship interior loot is now secured inside seven shipping containers; players must break them open (explosives/melee) to access loot, with one empty and one unlocked container containing brown crates.

2026-11-09.summary:
### Seamless Server Travel
- Fixed bugs that left players behind boats, caused sleeping, sinking boats, or duplicated/incorrect entities during server transfers.
- Enabled exiting vehicles and crossing between seamless servers, adding full neighbor connections, server links, vehicle transfers, and client handling for smoother travel.

### Base Building & Logistics
- Rewrote the conveyor system to move a fixed amount of items per tick, speed up when outputs near full, and resume scans after multi‑tick transfers.
- Fixed a UI bug where powered storage adaptors incorrectly displayed a power requirement message.

### World Content
- Added two Minicopter wrecks per map at monuments that can be repaired for gears, metal fragments, high‑quality metal, and a random tier‑2 modular car part.
- Implemented BoatDockTrigger on all fishing village docks, preventing vehicles from getting stuck and gently pulling them to the centre of water docks.

### Inventory & Combat
- Fixed AK rifle stacking display so a stack correctly shows 20 AKs instead of an erroneous label.
- Added a toggle to keep mouse sensitivity consistent across all weapons.
- Added an ammo indicator to the 40 mm Flashbang grenade.

### XCOM Mode Overhaul
- Introduced a major expansion to the experimental Rust XCOM mode, adding proper weapon handling, new enemy types, ladders, doors, manual furnace, full armoury with loadouts, melee options, overwatch, research, crafting, bases, terrain changes, camera controls, combat animations, cover improvements, loot drops, persistent squads, resource economy, repeatable raids, battle camera, and many other gameplay systems.

### Tools & Building
- Fixed a crash caused by a NullReferenceException in the Wire Tool preview, preventing crashes and missing wire previews.

### Loot & Exploration
- Cargo ship interior loot is now secured inside seven shipping containers; players must break them open (explosives/melee) to access loot, with one empty and one unlocked container containing brown crates.

2026-11-08.summary: No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.
